description: The Power Supply Position (PSP) daily report of Grid Controller of India Limited gives detailed data on the operation of India's electricity grid, and Climateverse India archives the reports as a data set (version 1.0, 2025) under CC0. The reports cover demand, supply, generation and exchange across regions and states, with peak demand, energy shortages, renewable generation, transnational exchanges, frequency profiles and generation outages, plus inter-regional and cross-border exchanges. Coverage is India by region and state at daily resolution. The archive is accessible online through the Climateverse India Dataverse, and the original reports are published on the Grid-India website. Caveats: neither the Climateverse page nor the Grid-India reports page could be opened from this environment on the day (connection failures), so this record rests on the DOI metadata, and the date range, file formats and completeness of the archive should be checked on the provider pages. Simulation uses are demand and shortage analysis, inter-regional flow studies and resource adequacy work for India. Related records: data-chetna-india-power-plants gives unit-level daily generation.
